acceptance: For each route that can run locally (PrestoDB container, ClickHouse pipeline, Doris verbose, chdb on a host where it loads, LakeSail with pysail), capture real output for scan+filter, join, aggregate and union/subquery shapes, add captured fixtures with engine/version sidecars and semantic tests, and fix parser defects found.
PROVENANCE.md marks a route validated only when it was actually run; anything still unrunnable keeps an explicit reason.
Athena stays unvalidated unless live-cloud spend is explicitly approved.
context: Follow-up to query-plan-live-semantic-validation (PR #3703) and query-plan-dataframe-contract-parity (PR #3711). Local engines and Mocker only; no cloud spend without approval. The chdb load failure may share a cause with chdb-4x-engine-load-verification-20261006.
description: Live semantic validation covered Spark, ClickHouse server, Trino, Databend, QuestDB, Doris and SingleStore. These routes are still unvalidated against real engine output: PrestoDB server and Athena (Presto/Trino parser), ClickHouse EXPLAIN PIPELINE, Doris EXPLAIN VERBOSE, ClickHouse chdb local mode (the installed chdb failed to load on macOS), and LakeSail DataFrame capture (pysail not installed; tested by dispatch with a local PySpark frame only). PROVENANCE.md records each as not live-validated.
